mission_01: Great start! You have built your first sklearn Pipeline, chaining StandardScaler, PolynomialFeatures, and LogisticRegression into a single, cohesive workflow. The pipeline ensures that scaling and feature engineering are applied consistently to both training and test data, preventing the data leakage that occurs when preprocessing is done separately. With a single fit call, all steps are executed in sequence, and a single predict call applies all transformations before making predictions. This modular design makes it trivial to swap components, add new steps, or tune hyperparameters across the entire pipeline. Pipelines are the backbone of professional machine learning code, and mastering them is essential for building reliable, maintainable ML systems.
